Model.Name: Intuos 2026 Small
AlternateNames: 影拓创意数位板 S号
Model.Notes: Specs from Wacom China's spec sheet for the small (announced and opened for pre-order 2026-09-29) and Kuuube's Wacom Tablet Mastersheet. Ships with the Wacom Lite Pen, recorded under the placeholder PenId LITE-PEN until Wacom publishes its model code. Also works with Pro Pen 3 nibs and pens, the Wacom One pen, and Wacom-EMR stationery pens. Requires Windows 11, macOS 14, Android 14 or HarmonyOS 7 or later.
